label: Whatever is in POTENCY_2 in a respect at some time can be in act in it
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is in potency in a respect at some time can be in act in that respect, that is, the condition on times 'x is in act in r' is possible in the supplied sense of the tertia via's plenitude reading (STMT-PLENITUDE-OVER-INFINITE-PAST): realizability at some time. It reads Theta.8's priority of act in definition (1049b12-17, a potency is a potency for its act; Theta.3, 1047a24-26), orientation only, as this explicit bridge. Under DISAMB-CAN-BE-MODAL-CAPACITY the step starts from POTENCY_2, not from the IX.6 capacity CanBe (ABLE_TO_BE_1), and yields the plenitude-reading possibility, which is not accessible-world ModalCapacity (ABLE_TO_BE_2) either; no identification with either sense is made. InPotencyAt is the free POTENCY_2 parameter at each time.
